title: JSS^2
description: Bringing back the original JSS, includes Season 1 and 2.
body:
![JSS^2 Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02966307ad14a64918dd54628c84adca0866ad75.jpeg)

# Welcome to JSS^2!

JSS^2 is a Legacy4J/Lite Legacy based Minecraft Server, designed to give you the best legacy console edition multiplayer experience you can get! However, you can also join the server on Vanilla as well.

JSS^2 has TWO worlds for you to play on! By default, you will join into Season 2's world.

You can get to the Season 1 world in JSS^2 by running /season1 and you can go back to Season 2 by doing /season2 (A third one may come eventually)

## A brief history of JSS and JSS^2!

JSS^2's is basically a revival of the original JSS. It was comprised of three seasons.
- Season 1 lasted from May 2024 to December 2024. 
- Season 2 lasted from January 2025 to June 2025.
- Season 3 lasted from June 2025 to September 2025.

In September 2025, I took a break from the internet and also brought the server down during that time. This brings us to December 2025, when I came back and JSS^2 launched in a whitelist, invite only state. It then went public on February 18th, 2025.
